title: Delta — quieter
question: No plaques, no panel, no columns. Same data. Pick one, or say what still feels heavy.

options.label: Air
options.thesis: Just the number. Δ is a letter. BEST and LAST are captions. No box, no bar.
options.viewport: Centered -0.840 in green. Tiny BEST / LAST under. Floats on the game.
options.risk: No analog magnitude — if the bar is how you glance, this is too little.

options.label: Hair
options.thesis: The bar survives as a 2px line. Everything else is type.
options.viewport: Number over a hairline that fills left of zero. BEST and LAST cap the ends.
options.risk: At small deltas the fill is a short tick and may still feel like a pip.

options.label: Row
options.thesis: One baseline. Live delta, then BEST, then LAST. Nothing stacked.
options.viewport: Δ -0.840 then two quiet stacks: BEST 1:12.140 and LAST 1:12.480.
options.risk: Reads as a caption, not a widget — easy to miss at race speed.
